nom: Good Molecules Pure Cold-Pressed Rosehip Seed Oil

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the oil absorbs quickly without residue and some say it helped balance oiliness, though one reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin said it just left her skin feeling oily with no benefit.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including some with chronic dry, itchy or flaking skin, report the oil resolved dryness and kept skin comfortable through winter.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe the oil as balancing, smoothing and non-heavy, including some who lean dry or oily depending on season.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it caused no irritation or breakouts and even helped with flare-ups, while others report it broke them out, in one case with painful under-the-skin breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (ages roughly 38-70+) report visibly reduced fine lines, plumper and smoother skin, and improved under-eye hydration.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles, plumper and smoother skin, and improvement around the eyes; effects are described as gradual with consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry or normal skin, report the oil relieves dryness and locks in moisture through winter and after exfoliation; one reviewer said it did not resolve chronic dryness during NYC winters without pairing it with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report reduced redness and calmer skin over weeks of use; no dissent noted for this concern.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using it alongside tretinoin or other drying treatments report it restored comfort and reduced dryness/patchiness caused by medication.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of hyperpigmentation, acne scars, and dark spots with consistent use over weeks; one reviewer bought it specifically for dark circles and saw no difference.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including acne-prone ones, report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne; however, at least two reviewers describe significant breakouts, including cystic/painful pimples, and one reports clogged pores and scarring.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the oil does not feel greasy and even helps balance oily areas, but one oily-skin reviewer said it left her skin feeling oily with no other benefit.

aspects.libelle: Breakouts on sensitive or acne-prone skin

extraits.texte: The way this product ruined my face. It broke me out so bad on my cheeks and now i have a bunch of acne scars from it. Be careful this product definitely clogs pores

I use tretenoin which is very drying, and I have sensitive skin. Ive been mixing a couple drops of this oil with my moisturizer morning and night and its amazing how much happier my skin is, in the middle of winter! It is so gently hydrating, my skin is plump and happy. Its an antioxidant, too.

Okay, I dont right reviews often but I had to for this product, not only becuase its a great oil but because the bottle & dropper are the BEST I have ever used! 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 To say I am obsessed with the packaging of Good Molecules Rosehip Oil is a huge understatement lol. The oil itself is perfect for my combination leaning to dry skin with ACNE & ROSACEA! I use this with my acne prescriptions & after using FAB Ultra Repair Cream to help my skin not become dry & patchy due to the heavy medications. This oil works like a dream, you dont need much at all, 3 drops for the entire face. I know some people complained that the size is small but I personally love the little glass bottle and to have a DROPPER THAT ACTUALLY WORKS is worth having a little less product compared to similar products @ the same price 🤗💕

I have been loving this oil. After using it x2 daily for a few months my dry red skin has toned down in redness. Most oils will break me out but this one does not! Little to no scent and it isn't a bad one when/of there is. I love having this in my routine.

I love this oil! I have sensitive, aging, combination skin. I generally only buy "prestige" brands, but I've never found "the one" holy grail prestige facial product. I bought this randomly in the store without reading reviews which I rarely do. It is an oil, so yes, it goes on and your face feels like an oil slick. But once it dries down, it's amazing, especially the next morning. My skin has never looked so good! I have since repurchased it at least 5 times which surprises me because I'm also a product junky who rarely repeats purchases. This one is a keeper though!

I am not a huge fan of facial oil, but this was a game changer for my dry, sensitive, mature skin. I especially like to use it around my eyes, as my dry eye tolerates almost nothing in that area. No fragrance, and smell's unpleasant for a couple of minutes, but completely dissipates. Since using, my skin is so smooth, I don't even need an exfoliating product anymore. I will continue to buy this!! Good molecules has many great products, but this is my favorite. Use sparingly.
This oil is very hydrating and smells nice , however , i dont think its for my sensitive skin girlies !! it breaks me out every time !! :((
